name: Unwrap It!

pick.label: Pick a product
pick.heading: Pick a product and fix its packaging
lead: Most of what we buy comes in packaging nobody really thinks about, until it leaks, refuses to open or fills the recycling bin by Wednesday.

Choose a product with annoying, wasteful or just plain silly packaging and give it a completely new one. Cleverer, greener, funnier or just weirder. Here are some ideas, but you can choose your own. *Surprise us.*
pick.hint: Or click one to choose it.
pick.note: I'm not looking for a real engineering plan here, this is just for a bit of fun. Some ideas will be genuinely clever and some will only make sense at two in the morning. Both are welcome.

rows: What are you repacking? From the shelf or your own idea.
What's wrong with the pack now:
Too much plastic, impossible to open, always leaks, ends up in the wrong bin…
What is it made of? What shape is it? How do you open it? Can you refill it, eat it, return it?
Who buys it first? People who care about the planet, people who are just lazy, someone else?
Leaks, costs, a factory that can't make it, customers who just don't get it…
Why would someone choose it instead of the one next to it?

values.now: A plastic squeezy bottle that makes a rude noise and still hides the last ten per cent of the ketchup somewhere you can never reach.
values.newpack: Ketchup on tap: a big steel tank in every Späti in Friedrichshain. You bring your own glass bottle, fill it up and pay by weight.
values.who: Students who put ketchup on everything, and people who already take their own jars to the unpackaged shop.
values.wrong: Somebody leaves the tap open at 2 a.m. and the Späti floor turns red. Also, nobody brings their bottle back a second time.
values.shelf: It isn't on a shelf at all, which is either genius or the reason it fails. The first bottle is free, and the queue becomes the advert.

yours.label: Your new pack
yours.heading: Your idea
yours.lead: Fill it in on your own phone or laptop (it stays on your device), and be ready to tell the class about your new pack in a few sentences.

rank.label: The ranking
rank.heading: Which new pack wins?
rank.placeholder: The pack, e.g. Ketchup on tap
rank.lead: Each student tells us about their new pack in a few sentences. Add it, then argue it into place until everybody agrees.
